About Me

Crafted with Intention

Starting with an idea and making it visible for the naked eye to appreciate is pure joy. I have been designing since I was old enough to rearrange my mom's living room — and that same attention to detail carries into everything I do.

My services go beyond design. I take on the tasks that take up your time — cleaning, errands, document work, and more. Each job is a one-time engagement: you bring the need, I bring the skill, and we part ways satisfied — unless you have more work that needs doing.

I am intentional about what I accept. That selectivity is what ensures every client gets my full attention and my best work.

Angelina N. Tesen
Founder & Creative Director
